caseName: Walker v. Fed. Reserve Bank of Richmond
caseNameFull: Charles Edward WALKER v. FEDERAL RESERVE BANK OF RICHMOND.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed until June 18, 2013, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
